proposal.reason: Main change is a new distributable tarball build/packaging path: the hggcrt12/13 build scripts and test-bundle script now perform real SDK/toolchain setup, compile, validate, and package PCCL/pccl-tests artifacts across OS/runtime variants (build). The PR also adds a substantial GitHub Actions matrix pipeline with scheduling, fan-out, artifact merge/publish, and runner/concurrency controls, which is independent CI workflow execution logic (ci).
